title_zh: 印度劳动力供给决策的耦合：一项实验研究
title_primary: 印度劳动力供给决策的耦合：一项实验研究
title_secondary: Coupling Labor Supply Decisions: An Experiment in India,
source: Journal of the European Economic Association
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Joint household decision-making becomes more common as economies develop. Can external intervention advance this transition? We study this question in the context of female employment in India. We randomized which spouse was given a ticket enabling enrollment in a women’s weaving job, and cross-randomized the other to receive no information about the ticket, information, or information and discussion with their spouse. Academic and local experts predict information and discussion should raise enrollment. Instead, information had no effect, and discussion reduced enrollment by 50%. We do not find an effect of giving the wife the job ticket rather than the husband. Our results show that interventions toward joint decision-making about an opportunity can lower take-up.
abstract_zh: 随着经济的发展，家庭联合决策变得越来越普遍。外部干预能否推动这一转变？我们在印度女性就业的背景下研究这一问题。我们随机分配了哪一方配偶获得一张可报名参加女性织布工作的票，并交叉随机分配另一方配偶分别处于三种情况：未获知票的信息、获知信息、或获知信息并与配偶讨论。学术专家和当地专家预测，信息与讨论应能提高报名率。然而，信息并未产生效果，而讨论则使报名率降低了50%。我们未发现将工作票给予妻子而非丈夫会产生影响。我们的结果表明，针对机会的联合决策干预措施可能降低参与率。

title: Dynamic Self‐Fulfilling Fire Sales
title_zh: 动态自我实现的抛售潮
title_primary: 动态自我实现的抛售潮
abstract: Why do fire sales occur if many risks are hedgeable? We study a version of Brunnermeier and Sannikov (2014, American Economic Review 104, 379–421) in which all fundamental risks can be hedged frictionlessly. Our analysis shows that fire sales are inherently self‐fulfilling. Fundamental shocks can never cause fire sales, and an efficient, safe equilibrium exists. On the other hand, there exists an equilibrium in which agents coordinate fire sales on nonfundamental shocks. A simple refinement based on vanishingly small perceived fundamental risk eliminates the safe equilibrium and selects the fire‐sale equilibrium as the unique outcome.
abstract_zh: 如果许多风险都是可对冲的，为何还会发生抛售潮？我们研究了Brunnermeier和Sannikov（2014，《美国经济评论》第104卷，第379–421页）的一个版本，其中所有基础性风险均可无摩擦对冲。分析表明，抛售潮本质上是自我实现的。基础性冲击永远不会引发抛售潮，且存在一个高效、安全的均衡。另一方面，存在一个均衡，其中经济主体在非基础性冲击上协调引发抛售潮。一个基于极小感知基础性风险的简单精炼方法消除了安全均衡，并将抛售潮均衡选为唯一结果。

abstract_zh: 尽管经济学家已广泛研究了影响女性的性别规范，但关于男性应如何行为的社会规范——即男性气质规范——仍未被充分探索。本综述首先综合了其他学科对男性气质的研究，为经济学家理解男性气质规范提供了概念基础和实证模式。随后，我们探讨了男性气质规范的研究如何为关于性别差距和男性的经济学文献提供启示。

title: Housing Policy and Fertility Behavior in Egypt: Evidence from the 1996 Rental Liberalization
title_zh: 埃及住房政策与生育行为：来自1996年租赁自由化的证据
title_primary: 埃及住房政策与生育行为：来自1996年租赁自由化的证据
title_secondary: Housing Policy and Fertility Behavior in Egypt: Evidence from the 1996 Rental Liberalization
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Egypt's demographic trajectory has shifted markedly over recent decades, with fertility declines in the 1980s and 1990s followed by a reversal that peaked at 3.5 children per woman in 2014. While previous research has examined determinants such as women's employment, contraceptive use, and migration, the role of housing policy remains largely unexplored. This study investigates the impact of Egypt's 1996 rental market liberalization on fertility. Using four waves of the Egypt Labor Market Panel Survey (ELMPS) combined with district-level housing data from the 2006 Census, we exploit geographic and temporal variation in exposure to the reform. We examine whether women of marriageable age in 1996 living in districts with greater availability of liberalized rental units experienced different fertility outcomes. Results show that exposure to the reform increased the likelihood of childbearing and positively affected other fertility measures, including age at first birth and parity at ages 25, 30, and 35. Evidence suggests that earlier marriage is the main mechanism, consistent with the reform lowering housing constraints for young couples.
abstract_zh: 近几十年来，埃及的人口结构轨迹发生了显著变化：20世纪80年代至90年代生育率下降后出现逆转，于2014年达到每名妇女生育3.5个子女的峰值。尽管已有研究探讨了女性就业、避孕措施使用及人口迁移等影响因素，但住房政策的作用仍鲜有涉及。本研究考察了埃及1996年租赁市场自由化对生育率的影响。通过运用四轮埃及劳动力市场面板调查数据，结合2006年人口普查中的地区级住房数据，我们利用改革暴露程度的地理与时间差异进行分析。研究检验了1996年处于婚育年龄的女性中，居住在自由化租赁住房供应更充足地区的群体是否呈现不同的生育结果。结果表明，改革暴露程度提高了生育可能性，并对其他生育指标产生正向影响，包括初育年龄及25岁、30岁、35岁时的生育数量。证据表明，早婚是主要作用机制，这与改革降低了年轻夫妇住房约束的结论一致。

title: Turning pressure into power: climate risk exposure and corporate green transformation
title_zh: 化压力为动力：气候风险暴露与企业绿色转型
title_primary: 化压力为动力：气候风险暴露与企业绿色转型
title_secondary: Turning pressure into power: climate risk exposure and corporate green transformation
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-16 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Climate risk represents a systemic threat to global economic stability, forcing firms to fundamentally adapt. Drawing on risk-management and resource dependence theories, this study investigates how climate risk exposure (CRE) reshapes corporate green transformation (GT) using a panel of Chinese A-share non-financial firms (2016–2024). Our results indicate that elevated CRE acts as a disciplining force, significantly accelerating corporate GT. Mechanism analyses reveal that firms respond to this exposure strategically by advancing green technological innovation and improving environmental, social, and governance (ESG) performance. Furthermore, this positive effect is amplified under specific boundary conditions: robust internal digital capabilities, accessible supply chain finance, and active monitoring by institutional investors. Heterogeneity analyses demonstrate that this proactive transition is more pronounced among state-owned enterprises, large corporations, and firms in regions with high public environmental awareness. By quantifying this behavioural response, this study suggests that external climate pressure catalyzes internal sustainable power, providing micro-level evidence for differentiated policy interventions.Footnote11 Abbreviations: green transformation (GT); climate risk exposure (CRE); World Meteorological Organization (WMO); Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC); Task Force on Climate-related Financial Disclosures (TCFD); Network for Greening the Financial System (NGFS); Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG); China Research Data Services Platform (CNRDS); China Stock Market & Accounting Research (CSMAR); Management Discussion and Analysis (MD&A); propensity score matching (PSM); two-stage least squares (2SLS); two-stage instrumental variables generalized method of moments (2SIV-GMM); difference-in-differences (DID); state-owned enterprises (SOEs); small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs).
abstract_zh: 气候风险对全球经济稳定构成系统性威胁，迫使企业进行根本性调整。本研究基于风险管理和资源依赖理论，利用2016至2024年中国A股非金融企业面板数据，探讨气候风险暴露（CRE）如何重塑企业绿色转型（GT）。研究结果表明，气候风险暴露的升高作为一种约束力量，显著加速了企业的绿色转型。机制分析显示，企业通过推进绿色技术创新和改善环境、社会及治理（ESG）表现来战略性地应对这种暴露。此外，这一积极效应在特定边界条件下得到增强：强大的内部数字化能力、可获得的供应链金融以及机构投资者的积极监督。异质性分析表明，这种主动转型在国有企业、大型企业以及公众环保意识较高地区的企业中更为显著。通过量化这一行为反应，本研究提出外部气候压力能够催化内部可持续发展动力，为差异化政策干预提供了微观层面的证据。脚注1 缩写：绿色转型（GT）；气候风险暴露（CRE）；世界气象组织（WMO）；政府间气候变化专门委员会（IPCC）；气候相关财务信息披露工作组（TCFD）；央行与监管机构绿色金融网络（NGFS）；环境、社会与治理（ESG）；中国研究数据服务平台（CNRDS）；中国股票市场与会计研究数据库（CSMAR）；管理层讨论与分析（MD&A）；倾向得分匹配（PSM）；两阶段最小二乘法（2SLS）；两阶段工具变量广义矩估计（2SIV-GMM）；双重差分法（DID）；国有企业（SOEs）；中小企业（SMEs）。

title: Spatial disparity, information, and the economics of cool transportation: Insights from a randomized controlled trial in Nigeria
title_zh: 空间差异、信息与酷交通经济学：来自尼日利亚随机对照试验的启示
title_primary: 空间差异、信息与酷交通经济学：来自尼日利亚随机对照试验的启示
title_secondary: Spatial disparity, information, and the economics of cool transportation: Insights from a randomized controlled trial in Nigeria
authors: Yamauchi, Futoshi, Balana, Bedru B., Bawa, Dauda, Edeh, Hyacinth, Shi, Weilun
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Increased vertical integration and coordination are defining features of transforming and modernizing agricultural value chains in low- and middle-income countries, with important implications for market efficiency and farm-level transformation. However, research documenting these processes in modernizing domestic value chains is limited, and tends to focus on foreign direct investment and high-value food products. We study the rice value chain – the most important staple in Southeast Asia – in Myanmar and use unique data from domestic rice mills and farmers to analyze millers’ expansion into other businesses and services. We show that both modern and traditional mills serve as key nodes in local rice value chains, fulfilling diverse roles beyond processing at both the farm and post-farm levels and highlighting a co-development of modern processing and vertical integration. Yet, statistical tests that control for mill and farmer characteristics, respectively, show that modern mills are more engaged in vertical integration and coordination, particularly in post-farm value chain segments, highlighting the co-development of modern processing and business expansion. Consistent with this pattern in the miller data, farmers using a modern mill are more likely to receive complementary services – especially post-farm – and to adopt modern production practices more broadly. However, this expansion is uneven, reaching large farms more frequently than small and medium farms.
abstract_zh: 食物损失是价值链中经济效率低下的重要来源。在包括尼日利亚在内的许多发展中国家，大部分水果、蔬菜及其他易腐食品在收获后发生损失，其主要原因在于采后处理不当或采后管理技术（尤其是温控运输和冷藏等冷却技术）的采用率较低。为考察连接尼日利亚东北部蔬菜生产州与南部地区大型需求中心的冷链运输的经济影响，我们开展了一项随机对照试验。研究发现，冷链运输具有显著且统计意义重大的影响：原产地销售商的销售价格、收入和利润均大幅提升。目的地市场销售价格的上涨中，更大比例归因于冷藏（即通过冷却保持品质），其中约66%的涨幅来自冷却，另外34%来自运输。一项信息实验进一步表明，通过标注产地信息的标签传递品质改善信号，可在目的地市场产生价格溢价。这意味着，不仅缩小不同市场的供需缺口能带来显著经济收益，缓解空间信息不对称同样具有潜在的经济效益。

title: Estimating plant-based milk impacts on U.S. fluid milk prices and quantities
title_zh: 估算植物基奶对美国液态奶价格和数量的影响
title_primary: 估算植物基奶对美国液态奶价格和数量的影响
title_secondary: Estimating plant-based milk impacts on U.S. fluid milk prices and quantities
official: Crossref 元数据日期 August 202 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Per capita consumption of fluid cow’s milk has declined steadily in North America and Europe. In the United States, that well-known decline accelerated in percentage terms in the past two decades as the market for plant-based substitutes surged. This paper documents and explains significant impacts of plant-based products on the retail prices and quantities of fluid cow’s milk products in the United States, using a discrete-choice model of milk product demand with random coefficients. Demand estimates based on household purchase and store scanner data from 2018 to 2020 show that plant-based milk is more substitutable for organic and lactose-free cow’s milk products than for conventional cow’s milk. Based on our demand estimates, if plant-based milk products had not been available in the consumer choice set, the retail quantity of organic cow’s milk would have been 14.5%, lactose-free cow’s milk 10.2% higher, and conventional cow’s milk by 7.7% higher. The absence of plant-based alternatives would increase annual retail purchases of fluid cow’s milk by 1.46 gallons for a representative survey of households. In these data, each gallon of plant-based milk displaced 0.68 gallons of cow’s milk. While plant-based milk continues to affect the demand for fluid cow’s milk products, especially the higher-priced organic and lactose-free products, evidence shows that it has not been the primary driver in the recent accelerated decline in the consumption of fluid cow’s milk.

title: The impact of post-harvest training interventions on adoption and production behavior: evidence from black pepper farmers in Sri Lanka
title_zh: 采后培训干预对采用与生产行为的影响：来自斯里兰卡黑胡椒农户的证据
title_primary: 采后培训干预对采用与生产行为的影响：来自斯里兰卡黑胡椒农户的证据
title_secondary: The impact of post-harvest training interventions on adoption and production behavior: evidence from black pepper farmers in Sri Lanka
authors: E.A.G. Samanmalee Amarawansha, Daisaku Goto, Duc Tran
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-09 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: As agricultural development increasingly targets high-value crops and markets, food quality and safety have become critical. However, smallholder farmers often face barriers to adopting quality-enhancing practices in the post-production stage because of their limited access to reliable information. Most research on information provision emphasises the need to reduce quantity losses in staple crops, leaving a research gap with respect to quality improvements in high-value crops such as black pepper. This study addresses this gap by evaluating the impact of government training and farmer-to-farmer experience sharing on the adoption of post-harvest quality improvement practices and production behaviour. We conducted a randomized controlled trial with 660 black pepper farmers in the Matale District of Sri Lanka. We found that government training significantly improves the adoption of key post-harvest practices such as threshing, fresh berry grading, dry berry grading, and blanching and leads to a shift in production from low quality to high quality. Our findings highlight the importance of structured expertise-led training to improve the quality of high-value crops.
abstract_zh: 随着农业发展日益聚焦于高价值作物与市场，食品质量与安全已成为关键议题。然而，小农户在产后阶段采纳提升品质的做法时，常因获取可靠信息的渠道有限而面临障碍。多数关于信息提供的研究侧重于减少主粮作物的数量损失，对于黑胡椒等高价值作物品质提升的研究则存在空白。本研究旨在填补这一空白，评估政府培训与农户间经验分享对采纳产后品质改进措施及生产行为的影响。我们在斯里兰卡马塔莱区对660名黑胡椒种植户进行了随机对照试验。研究发现，政府培训显著提高了关键产后实践（如脱粒、鲜果分级、干果分级及烫漂）的采纳率，并促使生产从低品质向高品质转变。我们的研究结果强调了结构化、专家主导的培训对于提升高价值作物品质的重要性。

title: Unintended Effects of Water‐Saving Policy: Irrigated Corn Expansion in Türkiye
title_zh: 节水政策的非预期效应：土耳其灌溉玉米扩张
title_primary: 节水政策的非预期效应：土耳其灌溉玉米扩张
title_secondary: Unintended Effects of Water‐Saving Policy: Irrigated Corn Expansion in Türkiye
authors: Alper Demirdogen, Yener Ataseven, Emine Olhan, Mehmet Hasdemir
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
abstract: ABSTRACT Agriculture consumes 70% of global water resources, worsening a crisis where billions lack clean water. Governments seek innovative solutions to water scarcity. In late 2016, Türkiye implemented a policy designed to reduce agricultural water consumption by promoting water‐efficient crops (lentils and chickpeas) and requiring drip irrigation for corn farmers. Despite these incentives, our analysis shows that the policy had an unintended and counterproductive effect: It led to a significant expansion of irrigated corn cultivation in the targeted regions. Our study demonstrates that this outcome was driven by farmers responding to rational economic signals, as the enhanced support for water‐efficient crops was insufficient to overcome the superior profitability of corn. This finding demonstrates that water‐saving policies can backfire if they fail to account for the underlying economic drivers of crop choice, highlighting the critical need for careful incentive design.
abstract_zh: 摘要 农业消耗了全球70%的水资源，加剧了数十亿人缺乏清洁用水的危机。各国政府正在寻求解决水资源短缺的创新方案。2016年末，土耳其实施了一项旨在通过推广节水作物（扁豆和鹰嘴豆）并要求玉米种植户采用滴灌技术来减少农业用水消耗的政策。尽管有这些激励措施，我们的分析显示，该政策产生了意想不到且适得其反的效果：它导致目标地区灌溉玉米种植面积显著扩大。我们的研究表明，这一结果源于农民对理性经济信号的响应，因为对节水作物的强化支持不足以抵消玉米更高的盈利能力。这一发现表明，如果节水政策未能考虑作物选择背后的经济驱动因素，就可能适得其反，凸显了谨慎设计激励措施的至关重要性。

title: Taxation and business entry: Evidence from the Polish self-employment “Flat” tax
title_zh: 税收与商业进入：来自波兰自雇“统一”税的证据
title_primary: 税收与商业进入：来自波兰自雇“统一”税的证据
title_secondary: Taxation and business entry: Evidence from the Polish self-employment “Flat” tax
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-15 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: How does the tax treatment of entrepreneurial activity affect the decision to start a business? We study this question in the context of a major tax reform in Poland that introduced a flat tax for business owners, leaving the taxation of employees unchanged. Using a difference-in-differences approach and data on the universe of Polish taxpayers, we find that a 1 percentage point increase in the tax differential at the top of the income distribution leads to a 0.9% increase in the share of self-employed five years after the reform. The increase is primarily driven by transitions from employment to self-employment, in particular, solo self-employment (self-employment without dependent workers). Moreover, the transitions occur in industries with a high human-capital component. Altogether, we find that high-income taxpayers respond strongly to the increased attractiveness of self-employment by starting a business, that such behavior shows considerable persistence, that it accumulates over time, and much of it is likely to reflect income reclassification rather than genuine entrepreneurial activity.
abstract_zh: 创业活动的税收待遇如何影响创业决策？我们以波兰一项重大税制改革为背景研究此问题，该改革对企业主引入了统一税率，而雇员税收保持不变。利用双重差分方法及波兰全体纳税人数据，我们发现，在收入分布顶端，税收差异每增加1个百分点，改革五年后自雇比例上升0.9%。这一增长主要由从就业转向自雇，尤其是独自自雇（无受雇工人的自雇）所驱动。此外，这种转变发生在人力资本密集的行业中。总体而言，我们发现高收入纳税人对自雇吸引力的增强反应强烈，选择创业，此类行为表现出显著的持续性，随时间累积，且其中很大部分可能反映的是收入重新分类，而非真正的创业活动。

title: Redistribution and labor market inclusion
title_zh: 再分配与劳动力市场包容性
title_primary: 再分配与劳动力市场包容性
authors: Thomas Aronsson, Spencer Bastani, Khayyam Tayibov
abstract: This paper incorporates labor market inactivity and long-term unemployment into the framework of optimal redistributive taxation. We examine how a combination of education policy, public employment programs, unemployment benefits, and optimal income taxation can effectively address both redistributive goals and the persistent challenges of long-term unemployment. Our analysis shows that the second-best optimal policy typically implies overprovision of education compared with a policy rule that reflects only direct marginal benefits and costs. At the same time, public employment programs and unemployment benefits tend to be underprovided. Using numerical simulations, we illustrate how this policy mix adapts to varying preferences for redistribution, productivity disparities, and the proportion of individuals at risk of long-term unemployment.
abstract_zh: 本文将劳动力市场非活跃状态与长期失业纳入最优再分配税收框架之中。我们探讨了教育政策、公共就业项目、失业救济金及最优所得税如何协同作用，以有效应对再分配目标与长期失业这一持久挑战。分析表明，相较于仅反映直接边际收益与成本的政策规则，次优最优政策通常意味着教育供给过度。与此同时，公共就业项目与失业救济金则倾向于供给不足。通过数值模拟，我们展示了这一政策组合如何适应不同的再分配偏好、生产率差异以及面临长期失业风险人群的比例变化。

title: Settlers and norms
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-02-26 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The distinctive traits of early settlers at the initial stages of institutional development may be crucial for cultural formation. In 1973, cultural geographer Wilbur Zelinsky formalized this idea in his doctrine of “First Effective Settlement.” I examine this doctrine and identify its short- and long-run implications for gender norms in the United States. To capture counties at early stages of cultural and institutional development, I focus on county creation events and proxy early settlers’ gender norms using historical female labor force participation rates and women’s financial rights in their places of origin. I document the distinctive characteristics of early settler populations and provide suggestive evidence of the transmission of gender norms across space and time. The results show that women’s labor supply is higher, both in the short and long run, in United States counties that historically hosted larger foreign-born early settler populations from places with high female labor force participation. I provide evidence for four reinforcing mechanisms underlying this persistence: foundational influence during critical junctures, demographic dominance, intergenerational cultural transmission, and political dominance. Together, these findings shed new light on how immigrants’ cultural endowments can have durable effects when introduced during critical junctures of institutional formation in host societies.

title: Board reform of controlling shareholders and soft budget constraints in state-owned enterprises: evidence from a parent board reform in China
title_zh: 控股股东董事会改革与国有企业软预算约束：来自中国母公司董事会改革的证据
title_primary: 控股股东董事会改革与国有企业软预算约束：来自中国母公司董事会改革的证据
title_secondary: Board reform of controlling shareholders and soft budget constraints in state-owned enterprises: evidence from a parent board reform in China
authors: Shuai Qin Chenxi Wang Qi Liu a School of Management, Guangdong University of Technology, Guangzhou, Guangdong, Chinab School of Business, Sun Yat-sen University, Guangzhou, Guangdong, Chinac School of Sport Business 等
abstract: This article examines whether and how stronger the board monitoring in a ultimate parent company of SOEs influence the soft budget constraints of affiliated subsidiary firms. Using a quasi-natural experiment in China, we empirically document that strengthening board monitoring at the parent company help reduce soft budget constraints in its listed subsidiaries. Mechanism analysis identifies channels in such a relationship, such as a reduction in political intervention. Furthermore, we find that the impact is more pronounced in state-owned enterprises, where controlling shareholders’ boards exhibit greater independence and in firms experiencing more intense political intervention prior to the reforms. This paper not only expands the research on the influence of political interference on financial market, but also contributes to the literature on the governance effect of controlling shareholders and board reform.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了国有企业最终母公司加强董事会监督是否以及如何影响其下属子公司的软预算约束。利用中国的准自然实验，我们实证发现，加强母公司层面的董事会监督有助于减少其上市子公司的软预算约束。机制分析揭示了这一关系中的传导渠道，如政治干预的减少。此外，我们发现，在控股股东董事会独立性更强的国有企业以及改革前经历更强烈政治干预的企业中，这一影响更为显著。本文不仅拓展了关于政治干预对金融市场影响的研究，也为控股股东治理效应及董事会改革的文献做出了贡献。

title: Beyond IQ: The Rising Value of Extraversion
title_zh: 超越智商：外向性的价值上升
title_primary: 超越智商：外向性的价值上升
title_secondary: Beyond IQ: The Rising Value of Extraversion
abstract: We analyze trends in labor-market returns to psychological traits using data from half a million Finnish men from 2001 to 2015. Cognitive skills' value declined, while noncognitive skills' value increased. Our novel findings show that extraversion drives this rise, while conscientiousness remains stable. Extraversion's rising returns are most pronounced for lower earners and those on the employment margin. These traits predict different labor market paths: extraversion predicts lower education and more work experience, while cognitive ability and conscientiousness lead to higher education and high-paying jobs.
abstract_zh: 我们利用2001年至2015年50万芬兰男性的数据，分析了劳动力市场对心理特质的回报趋势。认知技能的价值下降，而非认知技能的价值上升。我们的新发现表明，外向性推动了这一上升趋势，而尽责性则保持稳定。外向性回报率的上升在低收入者和就业边缘人群中最为显著。这些特质预测了不同的劳动力市场路径：外向性预示着较低的教育水平和更多的工作经验，而认知能力和尽责性则导向更高的教育水平和高薪工作。
